title: a different suburb/neighborhood
content: It's been a while since I've been to the mall world, but the other night I did manage to spawn in briefly (before my loud ass neighbors woke me up) to a different suburb than I've been to in the past. The neighborhood I normally go to has houses that all look like they were built at the same time but are slightly different. The owners put their own twists on their lots, you know? Like... Like a normal kind of lower middle class suburb without an HOA. If that makes sense. This one was way more winding, and seemed to be somewhere that had a lot of hills. The houses seemed to all be dark red brick with dark roofs, and I immediately got the feeling that I was in the mall world. I felt a little lost, like I often do when I first show up, but was very determined to find my way out of the suburbs and to somewhere with a bigger road. Unfortunately I'm pretty sure I was still pretty deep in the suburb when I woke up suddenly, which absolutely frustrates the hell out of me.
